fee_notes: Single uniform Initial Franchise Fee of $49,500 for a Standard Territory, due upon signing the Franchise Agreement. In addition, a Training and Territory Fee of $19,500 is required (also due at signing, non-refundable except as noted). Additional zip codes may be purchased at $0.50 per targeted dog. An Additional Training Fee of $7,500 applies if a partner attends a separate initial training class or more than two people attend. A 50% partial refund of both the Initial Franchise Fee and Training and Territory Fee is available if the franchisee does not complete initial training to Bark Busters' reasonable satisfaction and returns all supplied materials.
raw_excerpt: You pay a lump sum franchise fee of forty-nine thousand five hundred ($49,500.00) dollars ("Initial Franchise Fee") for a Standard Territory (See Item 12) that is due upon your signing of the Franchise Agreement. ... All Initial Franchise Fees for Standard Territories are uniform. In addition to the Initial Franchise Fee, you must pay us a training and territory fee ("Training and Territory Fee") of nineteen thousand five hundred ($19,500.00) dollars.
